title: Measure a hidden ensemble distance through chronological adjoint words
statement: The forward experiment starts in mu, reads f, executes u followed by the reversed forward-call list of v using fresh noise, and reads f again. Its mean is K(u,v)=<rho_u,rho_v>. The three-entry difference is full hidden L2 distance; TV contraction gives every common later receiver bound sqrt(D)/2. The literal witness uses fresh reversed words and endpoint coins, with gap D/(2B)-2zeta under test-probability error zeta. No trajectory reversal, copying or finite hidden rank is supplied.
